import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import warnings
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import xgboost as xgb

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Identify feature columns (exclude id and species)
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "species"]]

X = train_df[feature_cols]
y = train_df["species"]
X_test = test_df[feature_cols]

# Encode labels
le = LabelEncoder()
y_encoded = le.fit_transform(y)

# Split for validation (80/20)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y_encoded, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_encoded
)

# Train XGBoost on validation split
xgb_clf = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    objective="multi:softprob",
    num_class=len(le.classes_),
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    verbosity=0,
    random_state=42,
    use_label_encoder=False,
    eval_metric="mlogloss",
)
xgb_clf.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Predict probabilities on validation set
val_probs = xgb_clf.predict_proba(X_val)

# Calculate log loss
val_loss = log_loss(y_val, val_probs)
print(f"Validation Multi-class Log Loss: {val_loss}")

# Train on full training data for submission
xgb_clf_full = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    objective="multi:softprob",
    num_class=len(le.classes_),
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    verbosity=0,
    random_state=42,
    use_label_encoder=False,
    eval_metric="mlogloss",
)
xgb_clf_full.fit(X, y_encoded)

# Predict on test set
test_probs = xgb_clf_full.predict_proba(X_test)

# Create submission dataframe
# Ensure columns match sample_submission exactly
sub_species_cols = sample_sub.columns[1:]
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(test_probs, columns=le.classes_)

# Reindex to match sample submission column order
# If a class is missing in training, fill with 0
submission_df = submission_df.reindex(columns=sub_species_cols, fill_value=0.0)

# Insert id column
submission_df.insert(0, "id", test_df["id"])

# Save submission
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
